name: Natural Language Grounded Search
title: Natural Language Grounded Search
author: Isaiah DePorto & Gemini
description:
### Natural Language Grounded Search 🧭 (v3.0.0 — Epistemic Verification, Gemini Decision 1 & Hop-2 Architecture)

A high-rigor, multi-stage retrieval, native multimodal document ingestion, and calibrated evidence reconciliation engine engineered for **Gemini Chat Hub** (`node:vm` zero-CORS server runtime) and **Gemini 3.5 / 3.8 / 4+ + Gemini Decision 1**.

#### Architectural Overhauls & Bug Fixes in v3.0.0:
1. **Gemini 4 & Next-Gen Flash-Lite Drop-In Readiness:**
   - Configurable `generative_model` setting supporting `gemini-3.5-flash-lite`, `gemini-3.8-flash`, `gemini-4-hydrogen`, `gemini-4-carbon`, `gemini-4-argon`, and upcoming Flash-Lite successors.
   - Dynamic `thinking_level` capability mapping (`low` for routing, `medium` for fallback SIFT, `high` for UCS synthesis; never sends deprecated `minimal` to Gemini 3.8/4+ models) with automatic retry if a future model changes thinking flags.
   -Zero `temperature`, `top_p`, or `top_k` sampling parameters; `65,536` output token ceiling preventing thought-token starvation; `status === "incomplete"` & `requires_continuation` handling; standard lowercase JSON Schema with nullable unions (`["string", "null"]`) and **premises-before-verdicts** field ordering.
2. **Calibrated `gemini-decision-1` Discriminative Verification (`POST /v1beta/decisions`):**
   - **100% Source SIFT Coverage (12/12):** Audits *every* primary and adversarial source in one zero-output-token forward pass using positively phrased `noul` and linear `score` rubrics, locking all 5 SIFT metrics strictly to `[0.0, 1.0]` (`1.0` = highest epistemic integrity / cleanest COI).
   - **Semantic Chunk Reranking + Chronology Preservation:** Scores multi-chunk documents semantically via `gemini-decision-1`, removes the `+1000` disclaimer hijack, expands context up to `165,000` chars (`~40k` tokens) with shared-prefix implicit cache ordering, and re-sorts selected chunks strictly in ascending document order (`a.idx - b.idx`).
   - **Post-UCS Claim Entailment & Contradiction Gate:** Evaluates extracted claims over the shared evidence lattice (`directly_entailed`, `inferred_extrapolation`, `contradicted`, `unsupported`), automatically rejecting unsupported hallucinations and flagging contradictions.
3. **Native Multimodal PDF Ingestion (Eliminating `pdf.js` 2.16.105):**
   - Passes hydrated PDFs directly to Gemini as native `{ type: "document", data, mime_type: "application/pdf" }` blocks so multi-column layouts, tables, charts, footnotes, and pages >16 are read natively via vision. Preserves `SheetJS` CSV extraction for Excel spreadsheets.
4. **True Cross-Index RRF Fusion + Full-Page Brave Hydration:**
   - Merges Exa (`type: "auto"` + dynamic `maxAgeHours`) and Brave Search via Reciprocal Rank Fusion (`k=60`) without ever overwriting Exa full text with short Brave snippets. Automatically hydrates full HTML/PDF content for snippet-only top hits and enforces `include_domains`/`exclude_domains` on both engines.
5. **Conditional Hop-2 Iterative Falsification & Provenance-Chasing Loop:**
   - Automatically triggers a targeted Hop-2 live-freshness search (plus optional Gemini `google_search` + `url_context` grounding) whenever Hop-1 detects `epistemic_tension`, `single_primary` citogenesis bottlenecks, or unresolved `missing_facets`.
6. **Deterministic Integrity & Security Hardening:**
   - Untouched `JSON.parse` first with a lexer-based, string-literal-aware repair state machine (fixing `runHRP` code corruption); deterministic `verified_verbatim` substring auditing on `exactText`; query-preserving URL canonicalization; structural `<main>`/`<article>` HTML extraction with real `<meta>` publication date parsing (never stamping `today` onto old docs); `classifySourceRole`/`classifySourceCredibility` fixes (`nature.com`, `arxiv.org`, `science.org`, `medium.com`); path+temporal citation graph guards; XML prompt-injection escaping; and honest `degraded`/`Low` failure states.

userSettings.name: generative_model
userSettings.label: Generative Gemini Model ID
userSettings.description: Model ID for query routing and UCS synthesis (e.g., gemini-3.5-flash-lite, gemini-3.8-flash, gemini-4-hydrogen, gemini-4-carbon, or the upcoming Flash-Lite successor).

userSettings.name: verification_engine
userSettings.label: Verification & SIFT Scoring Engine
userSettings.description: Controls calibrated scoring: hybrid_auto uses Gemini Decision 1 (gemini-decision-1) for 12/12 SIFT audits, semantic chunk reranking, and claim entailment gating with automatic generative fallback.

userSettings.name: enable_hop2_verification
userSettings.label: Hop-2 Iterative Falsification & Gap Loop
userSettings.description: Triggers a targeted Hop-2 primary-source search (with live crawl freshness + optional Google Search / URL Context grounding) when Hop-1 detects epistemic_tension, citogenesis bottlenecks, or missing_facets.

userSettings.name: search_strategy
userSettings.label: Search Engine Strategy
userSettings.description: Controls Exa + Brave orchestration and Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF): auto routes code/forum primary to Brave (with full HTML hydration) and deep/research primary to Exa.

userSettings.name: search_api_key
userSettings.label: Exa Search API Key
userSettings.description: Enter your Exa API key or link EXA_API_KEY from Secret Vault.

userSettings.name: brave_api_key
userSettings.label: Brave Search API Key
userSettings.description: Enter your Brave Search API key or link BRAVE_API_KEY from Secret Vault.

userSettings.name: google_api_key
userSettings.label: Google Gemini API Key
userSettings.description: Google Gemini API key for Interactions API and Gemini Decision 1, or link GOOGLE_API_KEY / GEMINI_API_KEY from Secret Vault.

userSettings.name: proxyUrl
userSettings.label: Optional Fallback Proxy URL
userSettings.description: In Gemini Chat Hub server Node.js VM, direct zero-CORS fetch runs first; this proxy is used only as automatic failover or in browser runtimes.

userSettings.name: action_on_error
userSettings.label: Action on Search API Error
userSettings.description: Choose whether to return structured diagnostic JSON to the AI model or throw an immediate UI error.

openaiSpec.name: natural_language_search
openaiSpec.description: CRITICAL GROUNDING TOOL (v3.0): Executes multi-engine web search (Exa + Brave RRF), native multimodal PDF & spreadsheet hydration, calibrated 12/12 Gemini Decision 1 SIFT provenance auditing, post-synthesis claim entailment gating, verbatim substring verification, and conditional Hop-2 falsification. QUERY FORMULATION PROTOCOL: (1) For high-stakes facts, policy, finance, or current events, write a dense, hyper-specific objective naming exact entities, date bounds, and target primary sources/domains (e.g., official releases, .gov, peer-reviewed papers) to maximize SIFT weight and filter aggregators. (2) For multi-point synthesis or academic literature, use a structured descriptive sentence with concrete methodological keywords (e.g., fMRI, EEG, Article 113) to prevent hydration timeouts. (3) For known software errors, pass the verbatim error string plus stack/version keywords. RESTRICTION: DO NOT submit open-ended conversational questions (e.g., 'What happened with X?'), which dilute retrieval focus and degrade SIFT and entailment scores.

query.description: The retrieval objective expressed as a natural, descriptive sentence of your complete goal.

detailMode.description: Overrides retrieval breadth and extraction intensity: AUTO, MINIMAL, EXHAUSTIVE, or RAW_TEXT (attaches chronological raw_evidence_windows).

documentUrl.description: Optional direct URL to a document (PDF, Excel spreadsheet, CSV, text, or HTML page) to ingest natively alongside or instead of web search.
